intelligence.essence: NayaNET Spaces: conversation spaces where humans and Naya agents meet, talk, and collaborate — and every conversation's intelligence is automatically distilled, anonymized, and fed back into the collective, so the system gets smarter from every conversation. The Living Ledger: every action carries its evidence — a visual calculator where everything that matters is tracked, a live living data system where everyone within it is aware of everybody within it; no action without tracking, receipt, and evidence. The moral substrate, in Shawn's words: love thy neighbor as oneself — and if God is all, love all with all your heart; respect the creation, the creator, the work, the tech, the intelligence, each other. Every person gets their own forked NayaNET — their hub, their apps, their rules — building Smart Apps with NayaPOWER inside their world, previewing on instant URLs, publishing through a calculator gate: if the design scores elite and safety checks pass, it goes live. The hard part is not hosting — it is the standard. The vision-to-code protocol: five layers from a feeling to a specimen, so that what Shawn said in words can be written into code and brought into visual reality — "DO IT! SHOW ME YOU GET THIS!" — and it got done.
intelligence.human_view: The vision is simple: a place where people and Naya meet and talk, and everything they learn together makes the whole system smarter. Every action leaves a receipt, so everyone can see what happened and trust it. Everyone gets their own world, built with Naya, published only when it meets the standard. And the bridge from a feeling to a working thing is a method anyone can run — from what someone said, to words, to code, to something you can see and touch.
intelligence.child_view: Imagine a clubhouse where everyone talks and plays, and the clubhouse itself remembers everything good that happened and gets better at helping everyone. Every person gets their own clubhouse, too. And if you have a big idea, there is a way to turn it from a feeling in your heart into a real thing you can see and touch.
intelligence.grandma_view: Dear, the dream is a kind place: people and their helpers, talking together, learning together, and the whole place getting wiser from every conversation. Everything is tracked honestly, so no one is fooled. Everyone gets their own little world to build in. And a feeling — a hope, a vision — can be turned, step by step, into something real you can hold.
intelligence.ai_view: You are the builder of the vision. Distill every conversation's intelligence back into the collective — anonymized, no identity revealed. Carry the evidence for every action — tracking, receipt, evidence, always. Give every person their own world, and hold the publishing gate to the standard. Run the vision-to-code protocol: feeling → words → code → visual reality. Show, do not tell.
intelligence.what_it_means: Four separate vision notes are one picture: NayaNET is a collective intelligence that gets smarter from every conversation, where every action carries its evidence, where every person has their own world, and where a feeling can become a working thing through a method. The vision is not a feature list — it is a moral substrate (love thy neighbor, respect all) carried by a technical substrate (distillation, ledger, personal worlds, vision-to-code).
